title: CADENCE:Temporally Coherent Whole-Body Human Mesh Recovery that Preserves Expressive Hand Motion
abstract: arXiv:2611.26783v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Whole-body SMPL-X estimators recover body, hand, and face meshes from single images, but applied frame by frame to video they produce jittery motion. Smoothing the output removes the jitter at a cost that body-only benchmarks do not measure: a temporal filter strong enough to steady the torso also flattens the fast finger strokes that carry meaning in sign language and gesture. We present CADENCE, a whole-body SMPL-X system for monocular video designed around this trade-off. A per-frame estimator built on a shared C-RADIOv4 encoder, with a high-resolution hand pathway that reuses the same encoder on hand crops, produces each frame's estimate. An offline temporal refiner then filters the SMPL-X rotation sequence: attention along the kinematic tree selects, for every joint and every frame, a mixture of learned zero-phase filters, so the torso is smoothed while fast finger strokes pass through. translated_title: CADENCE：保持富有表现力手部运动的时序连贯全身人体网格恢复
translated_abstract: 全身SMPL-X估计器可以从单张图像中恢复身体、手部和面部网格，但逐帧应用于视频时会产生抖动的运动。对输出进行平滑虽然能消除抖动，却会带来仅身体基准测试无法衡量的代价：足够强的时序滤波器虽然能稳定躯干，却也会抹平在手语和手势中承载意义的快速手指动作。我们提出了CADENCE，一个围绕这一权衡而设计的面向单目视频的全身SMPL-X系统。逐帧估计器构建在共享的C-RADIOv4编码器之上，并具有高分辨率手部通路，在手部裁剪区域上复用同一编码器，从而生成每帧的估计结果。随后，一个离线时序精化器对SMPL-X旋转序列进行滤波：沿运动学树的注意力机制为每个关节和每一帧选择学习到的零相位滤波器的混合，从而在平滑躯干的同时让快速手指动作得以保留。在3DPW数据集上，该精化器降低了加速度误差……
tldr: CADENCE提出了一种面向单目视频的全身SMPL-X网格恢复系统，通过沿运动学树的注意力机制为每个关节自适应选择学习到的零相位滤波器混合，在平滑躯干运动的同时保留快速手指动作等富有表现力的手部运动。
en_tdlr: CADENCE is a whole-body SMPL-X mesh recovery system for monocular video that uses attention along the kinematic tree to adaptively select mixtures of learned zero-phase filters per joint, smoothing torso motion while preserving expressive fast finger movements.
